summary: Support new metadata types through a focused internal scanner registry first
rationale: The current scanner is modular and already has type-specific scanner modules; an internal generic registry keeps the release slice reviewable while preserving a future path to @salesforce/source-deploy-retrieve registry adoption.
outcome: Implement directory and file detection for the issue-listed metadata types with tests, add AiAuthoringBundle/CustomSite/DigitalExperienceBundle types and ordering where missing, and defer full SDR registry replacement to a later architecture task.

summary: Propagate project API version into manifest generation instead of hardcoding package.xml version
rationale: The issue combines metadata type misclassification with manifest version drift; fixing only the scanner would still emit the wrong package version for sourceApiVersion 66.0 projects.
outcome: Add a stable apiVersion field to scan/deployment context or manifest params, default safely when unavailable, and cover with manifest tests.

summary: Normalize forceignore checks against both package-relative and project-relative paths
rationale: Issue patterns include force-app/main/default/... and **/aiAuthoringBundles/**; directory scans must evaluate paths in the same shape users put in .forceignore.
outcome: Enhance ForceIgnoreParser matching without replacing it wholesale, and add regression tests for the exact aiAuthoringBundles patterns.

summary: Parked regenerated QA Playwright/WDIO scaffold files into gitignored qa-scaffolds/ (retry 4 of release gate)
rationale: yarn build (tsc+eslint) and yarn test:only failed because sf setup-agents local --profile qa regenerated 4 untracked files (playwright.config.ts, src/utils/salesforce-api.ts, src/utils/salesforce-auth.ts, test/mobile/**) that the build/lint pipeline does not expect and @playwright/test is not a project dependency; the plugin has no UI to test with Playwright. Per user-chosen option A, followed the existing convention from commit 50fffc3 which already parks this exact scaffold shape under gitignored qa-scaffolds/ (playwright.config.ts, src-utils/*, mobile/*). Moved the untracked copies into qa-scaffolds/, overwriting the parked copies after verifying byte-identical diffs (kept the newer test/mobile/specs/smoke-test.e2e.ts content). Confirmed via yarn build (pass) and yarn test:only (1820 passing/8 pending/0 failing, 92.87% coverage, meets baseline). Residual risk: a human-run sf setup-agents local --force regenerated the same 4 files again mid-phase (confirmed live during this run), forcing a second move-and-rerun cycle before build/test passed clean; any future --force/local re-run will reintroduce them into src/ and test/mobile/ and must be re-parked the same way until the QA profile's scaffold generator itself is changed to write directly into qa-scaffolds/.
alternatives: Add @playwright/test as a dependency and keep the scaffolds in src/test trees (rejected: no UI exists to test with Playwright per story context, and this would add an unused/ungoverned dependency); change .gitignore or build/lint config to exclude the scaffold paths in place (rejected by user decision: option A convention of parking outside the build tree already exists and should be reused, not a new exclusion mechanism).

summary: Release phase retry 5 at HEAD 96221ef: required-checks FIXED, setup-health still blocks on a structural conflict; not remediated, reported to developer/human
rationale: required-checks was a release-check evidence-keying issue, not a real build/test failure: requiredCheckKey() has no special-case for a combined 'yarn build && yarn test:only' command, so it falls back to using the literal command string as the key (release-check.ts line ~1702), and that combined-command key never supersedes the separately-keyed 'yarn build' and 'yarn test:only' exit-1 records from the prior scaffold-collision run (setup-agents-evidence-1793236690010-e71c3c, setup-agents-evidence-1793236738487-7e4fb3). I independently re-ran both commands at HEAD 96221ef (yarn build exit 0; yarn test:only exit 0, 1820 passing/8 pending/0 failing, coverage 92.87%) and recorded them under the exact literal keys the gate expects; required-checks now passes. setup-health is a genuine structural conflict, not something a local-only release phase can fix: the developer's retry-4 fix (moving the regenerated Playwright/WDIO scaffold files to gitignored qa-scaffolds/ so yarn build/test:only stop failing on them) necessarily makes setup-manifest.json's 7 expectedArtifacts entries for those same paths report 'missing', because setup-health checks the ORIGINAL generated paths (playwright.config.ts, src/utils/salesforce-api.ts, src/utils/salesforce-auth.ts, test/mobile/**), not qa-scaffolds/. The only repair setup-health itself names is 'sf setup-agents local --force' (human-only per AGENTS.md), and running it would regenerate the scaffolds at their original paths and reintroduce the build/test failures the developer just fixed -- the two failure modes are mutually exclusive outcomes of the same file-location decision until the plugin's setup-manifest is regenerated to point at qa-scaffolds/ (a developer/plugin-maintainer task, not a release action) or the scaffold dependency (@playwright/test, webdriverio) is actually added to this repo. Separately, .setup-agents/skills/project-knowledge-bootstrap/SKILL.md is flagged drifted/skipped (actual sha256 bb9ef862... vs manifest-expected 78d28511...) independent of the scaffold issue -- also only fixable via --force. Not remediated: fixing setup-health requires either a human-run 'local --force' (forbidden to this agent session) or a plugin/story-level decision about where the QA scaffolds permanently live; neither is in this release phase's local-only scope.
